news_trading: Allowed on all accounts at every stage
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: on Fundamental/Premium, robots, fully automated algorithms and HFT are not permitted; semi-automated tools are allowed only with active manual monitoring
copy_trading: Allowed, including third-party copier software, within per-type account caps (5 CASH Fundamental, 5 CASH Premium, 5 E2L). Accounts may be suspended if identical strategies exceed the maximum allowed capital
overnight_weekend_holding: Premium: overnight and weekend allowed. Fundamental and E2L: not allowed; positions must be closed before the daily cutoff, and failing to close means disqualification. E2L LIVE: not allowed unless agreed
restricted_countries_note: Annex 1 of the terms lists about 59 restricted countries, including Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Kosovo, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Romania, Albania, Malta, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Indonesia, South Africa and Russia. The US is not on the list. https://phidiaspropfirm.com/tou
path_to_live: E2L: automatic. Hit the target and click 'Switch to Live' for a LIVE account at Dorman Trading. Fundamental/Premium: discretionary review from 5 payouts or $100,000 cumulative profit; the earlier 3 payouts / $75,000 threshold is marked deprecated. Further tiers: ELITE LIVE (60 days + $125K balance) and MASTER LIVE (120 days + $250K). One LIVE account per trader.

current_public_promo.discount: 60% off monthly plans, 85% off one-time plans
current_public_promo.applies_to: Shown in the account configurator on Phidias' homepage

affiliate_program.commission: 15% 'starting commission' on every sale made with the affiliate code, no cap; also applies to resets/new accounts/upgrades bought with the code
affiliate_program.notes: Anyone can apply (no need to be a Phidias trader). Applications reviewed within ~24h. Paid monthly via Rise.

recent_changes_2026.change: Discretionary path-to-LIVE threshold raised to 5 payouts or $100,000 cumulative profit; previous 3 payouts / $75,000 marked deprecated (About page still shows old thresholds)

pros: News trading allowed on all accounts at every stage
No daily loss limit on Fundamental, Premium or E2L
E2L has no consistency rule, no minimum days, and an automatic route to a LIVE account cleared by Dorman Trading
Premium allows overnight and weekend holding and reaches a 100% split from the 5th payout
US residents are not on the restricted list
cons: Trustpilot rating is withheld for a guidelines breach and Trustpilot says it removed fake reviews; about 34% of the 339 reviews are 1-star, many alleging denied payouts (unverified)
Long restricted-country list, including most of the Balkans (Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Romania)
E2L static drawdown is small: $650 on 50K
Fundamental/Premium payouts are capped at $2,000 per period (50K), and Fundamental pays only every 10 trading days
Some official pages contradict each other: the 30% rule is worded as 'total balance' vs 'total profit', and the E2L activation fee and path-to-live thresholds differ between pages
best_for: US and non-restricted futures traders who want news trading, no daily loss limit, and either a fast static-drawdown route to a live account (E2L) or overnight/swing holding (Premium).
